reason: Both plans satisfy every hard requirement (three phases with percentages/entry criteria, correctly formatted RISK lines, no decommissioning in the final migration phase, numeric halt thresholds, and a trailing PHASES: 3), but Response A is more operationally complete — it pairs each phase's entry criterion with an explicit exit criterion, gives phase durations and go/no-go checkpoints, and lists a dedicated Metrics/Halt section with four distinct thresholds plus a fifth risk (rollback failure) that B also covers but with slightly less structural rigor.
